verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents pipelines that, once configured, run continuously in the background: no-code warehouse-to-SaaS pipelines, continuous consent syncing, reverse ETL syncs, audience activation, in-flight transformations, and alerts on data issues. Its AI features (Rudder AI in Slack, the RudderStack MCP server) are documented only as interactive, on-demand natural-language tools, not as agents that act autonomously or on a schedule. missing for 10: autonomous or scheduled AI-agent tasks, agent-triggered background workflows, documented scheduling and trigger controls for agent automations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
